stem: Meera watches the Moon from her balcony in Jaipur every night for a month. She notices that the bright part of the Moon slowly changes from a thin crescent to a full circle and back again. What is the correct explanation for these changing shapes?

options.text: The Moon changes its own shape during the month
We see different amounts of the sunlit half of the Moon from Earth
The Moon makes more of its own light on some nights
Clouds cover different parts of the Moon each night

teacher.key_rationale: Phases occur because sunlight always illuminates half of the Moon, and from Earth we see changing portions of that illuminated half; the Moon's shape and light do not change, so B is correct.
